title: utensil jar
text: utensil jar. I purchased this because I needed something larger than I currently have.  I like this one because it was plastic (not metal - for rust or glass/ceramic for breakage), the bottom is weighted to keep upright and it spins.  It is white.  There is also a removable 3 way divider for the inside and I am currently using that.  It's nice not to struggle to pull out the utensil I want. The only down thing is that I wish it were about 1" or 2" deeper/taller.  Things would stay in a bit better... my utensils are not extra long - the usual length - I guess I just need to add some more utensils!  I never hesitate to update my reviews should new info seem useful.

features: EXTRA LARGE MEANS BIG! - Stop cramming your utensils into small metal cups, or into a drawer that can barely close. Our utensil caddy is a generous 7 inches in diameter, allowing you to free up drawer space and stop rummaging for utensils every time you cook. There's no kitchen tool that won't fit: spoons, spatulas, whisks and more! Tall and sturdy so none of your tools will fall out. Will hold approximately 15-20 large handled tools right on your counter for your convenience!

STURDY NO-TIP CONSTRUCTION - Our kitchen utensil organizer WILL NOT TIP OVER! Nothing is more frustrating than having your utensil holder tip over while you're cooking. Our jumbo utensil holder features a weighted base to keep it from tipping or sliding around during use. Stop using small, cheap cups that will tip and flip every time you use them. Our metal utensil holder is the REAL DEAL!

PERFECTLY DESIGNED - Unique modern Cooler Kitchen design features include 1) the convenience of a rotating base so you can reach every tool with ease on the fly 2) a tri-compartment divider to organize your tools more efficiently 3) a gripped insert at the bottom to ensure your tools don't slide around when in use 4) rubberized feet, so it won't scratch or stain your counter.

CLEANING IS A BREEZE - Our cutlery holder has rubberized feet to ensure that it won't harm your counter or slide around, and is completely RUST-PROOF. The divider and gripped insert are easily removable, for hassle-free cleaning. The whole utensil crock is 100% DISHWASHER SAFE!
